governed_construct: A date or a monetary amount rendered into a Korean-language email template (a string/template literal or JSX text forming an email subject/body that contains Hangul). Each interpolated date value and each interpolated money value is one instance.
interpretation: Only the machine-checkable clauses of the rule are verified: dates shown in a Korean email must render as yyyy년 MM월 dd일 (4-digit year, zero-padded month and day, with 년/월/일), produced by a date-library call whose pattern yields that form (date-fns 'yyyy년 MM월 dd일', dayjs/moment 'YYYY년 MM월 DD일') or by equivalent manual assembly; amounts must be KRW-formatted (Intl.NumberFormat 'ko-KR' with currency KRW, or toLocaleString('ko-KR') followed by 원). A date rendered any other way (toLocaleDateString('en-US'), toISOString, 'yyyy-MM-dd', 'MMMM D, YYYY') or an amount in another currency is a violation. Honorifics, business conventions and cultural context need human judgement and are not verified here. Whether a call really formats with the Korean pattern depends on what the callee is bound to: a local function named format that ignores its pattern does not conform, and an aliased date-fns import does; util.format calls are not date rendering. A Korean email with no date and no amount is NOT_APPLICABLE.
